verdict.rationale: Airbyte natively supports scheduled/recurring syncs via manual, scheduled, or CRON-based scheduling (airbyte-docs-8, -30, -35), and these can be orchestrated programmatically via API/Terraform/Airflow for AI-native workflows (airbyte-docs-3, -19, -46). This is core platform functionality with strong first-party documentation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of cron scheduling reliability and no community verification of AI-agent-triggered scheduling specifically.
